title: RECONLY — Automated Invoice Reconciliation & 3-Way Match
heroHeadline: Enterprise Vendor Reconciliation with Live PO, GRN and Invoice 3-Way Match
basicIntro: Welcome to RECONLY! I am Aayam. Let me show you how we eliminate accounts payable bottlenecks with automated 3-way matching across SAP S/4HANA Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, and Vendor Invoices.

cards.title: Strategic Accounts Payable Velocity
cards.botDialogue: Welcome to RECONLY! Manual three-way matching across paper invoices, POs, and goods receipts consumes hundreds of AP hours monthly. RECONLY automates 80.9% of matching on first pass.
bullets: Manual reconciliation across disparate POs, bilties, and invoices stalls payment cycles.
Pricing and quantity discrepancies trigger carrier disputes and vendor friction.
Delayed exception handling causes month-end financial close backlogs.

cards.title: Core Reconciliation Friction Points
cards.botDialogue: Notice the core friction points: line-item quantity variances between receiving docks and vendor invoices, currency exchange mismatches, and delayed debit note creation.
bullets: High exception rates requiring cross-departmental email chases between plant receivers and AP.
Lack of centralized multi-entity reconciliation cockpit across corporate group companies.
Manual data entry into SAP MIRO leading to duplicate payment vulnerabilities.

cards.title: Clean Core 3-Way Reconciliation Architecture
cards.botDialogue: Here is our decoupled reconciliation architecture on SAP BTP. Real-time OData feeds stream PO and GRN line items from S/4HANA into an autonomous rules engine, keeping core ledgers untouched.

cards.title: Interactive Reconciliation Command Cockpit
cards.botDialogue: Inspecting the live Reconly cockpit. Notice real-time visibility into 162 active invoices, 80.9% match confidence, and categorized financial exception work queues.

hotspots.label: Match Rate Telemetry
hotspots.tooltip: Live overview of 162 invoices with 80.9% automated clearance rate.

hotspots.label: Line-Item Tolerance Matrix
hotspots.tooltip: Autonomous variance comparison across unit prices, quantities, and tax codes.

hotspots.label: Automated MIRO Posting
hotspots.tooltip: One-click batch approval triggering touchless SAP MIRO accounting entries.

cards.title: 3-Step Governed Execution Flow
cards.botDialogue: From invoice intake to ledger clearance, our 3-step workflow ensures verified audit trails with zero manual data entry.

steps.title: Data Intake & OData Sync
steps.desc: Ingest vendor invoices via OCR/EDI and sync live S/4HANA PO and GRN line items.

steps.title: Autonomous 3-Way Match
steps.desc: Evaluate pricing tolerances, received quantities, and delivery milestones.

steps.title: Variance Routing & MIRO Settlement
steps.desc: Route exceptions to AP reviewers; auto-post verified records into SAP MIRO.

cards.title: SAP BTP & Clean Core Topology
cards.botDialogue: Built natively on SAP BTP Cloud Foundry runtime with Node.js 20, integrating with S/4HANA via Cloud Connector and secure OAuth 2.0 JWTs.

cards.title: Quantified Business ROI
cards.botDialogue: Delivering measurable financial agility: faster month-end close, eliminated duplicate payments, and verified carrier relationships.

cards.title: Deployment Readiness & Next Steps
cards.botDialogue: Ready to test RECONLY with your enterprise vendor invoices? Schedule an architecture workshop or test drive in our sandbox.

closing.liveDemoInfo: Live SAP BTP Cloud Foundry tenant (EU30) accessible for authenticated enterprise reviewers. Single Sign-On enabled.
